Kiran —

Quick notes to frame the agenda so we use the 30-min slot well if you pick that: 
- Dedicated sizing: rule of thumb is workload-dependent; for Llama2-70b we typically size around 40–60 tokens/sec sustained per A100-class equivalent when batching is small. A40 equivalence depends on qps and sequence lengths. I attached a short guide (Redwood_dedicated_sizing_v2.pdf) that shows expected throughput for common families and sequence lengths.
- If you expect many short queries (chat) at high concurrency, plan for KV cache memory and additional GPU headroom for bursts.
- For cost projection: we’ll prepare a 3-tier example (dev/pilot/prod) with burst policies and fallback model variants to control cost.

Prep requests: please confirm average prompt+response token lengths and typical peak qps (even a small table is helpful). I pulled the "June_snapshot" tab and will pre-populate an example in the workbook before the call.

Attachments: Redwood_dedicated_sizing_v2.pdf (pdf)

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
